name: Java Edition 1.21

sources.title: Shulkr schematic catalogue (incl. the TMC Catalogue archive)
YouTube farm tutorials (one link per design)

notes: Rates are items per hour per module as stated by the designer (basis "designer"), measured by Max on a 26.3 test server (basis "measured") or not published (basis "unknown", per_hour null). Community rates differ a lot between designs and test conditions; read the condition and the source before relying on a number. Footprint null = not published. Material lists are the main blocks from the schematic or the tutorial, not always complete; count null = amount not published. Where a source says "any slab" or "any trapdoor", a representative block is listed.

designs.name: Booty's 3 Pod Iron Farm

designs.condition: One zombie scares the villagers of three pods. Villagers must have slept; skipping the night lowers the rate (hopper clock variant available). On 1.21.2+ build the zombie platform at least 8 blocks above ground (wandering trader llamas kill the zombie).
